description: This file defines a service class `NotesService` for managing notes in memory, including CRUD operations and search functionality. It interacts with `Note` model objects and exposes methods for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, deleting, and searching notes.

classes.name: NotesService
classes.description: Service layer for managing notes in memory.

methods.name: Dict create_note(self, title: str, content: str, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new Note object and stores it in memory, returning its dictionary representation.

methods.name: List[Dict] list_notes(self, include_archived: bool = True)
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes, optionally excluding archived ones.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] get_note(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a note by ID, returns its dictionary representation if found.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] update_note( self, note_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] = None, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None, archived: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Updates attributes of an existing note and returns its updated dictionary.

methods.name: bool delete_note(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, returns True if successful.

methods.name: List[Dict] search(self, query: str)
methods.description: Performs a simple case-insensitive search over note titles and content.
